description: write-kv-pair-slot with what the port does. A kv_pair slot is part of a hash map's structure, and Zig writes it wherever it's given, which tests/invalid keeps out as an undefined use. The port refuses a write of one with StructuralSlot before writing anything (finding 3), so the transaction goes on and commits, and nothing is poisoned. Below the root with no transaction going, the engine's ExpectedTxStart comes first, as for any write. What the port writes is what Zig writes with those writes left out.

ops.note: as a value, where the map would take it for a pair of its own
nothing was written, so the transaction isn't poisoned
a write to the root is a transaction of its own, so it's refused too
below the root with no transaction going, as any write
